description: This file implements a QuicPacketPrinter class that logs various events and packet details during QUIC protocol processing, including error handling, version mismatch, packet headers, frames, and encryption events. It also includes a method to process and print packet data using a QuicFramer.

classes.name: QuicPacketPrinter
classes.description: A class that implements QuicFramerVisitorInterface to log detailed information about QUIC packets and frames during processing.

methods.name: QuicPacketPrinter::PrintWrite
methods.description: Processes a raw packet data string, sets up a QuicFramer and visitor, and returns a string with the logged packet details.
